title: Coordinator — what they may and may not do in Sales

steps.do: Open Left menu → Sales and each tile in turn: Leads, Opportunities, Inquiries, Quotes, Quote templates, Pre-order checklist, Project costing, Approvals, Pipelines & funnels, Set up Sales.
steps.expect: Opens exactly what the matrix allows; anything else is refused with a sentence (never a blank page or an error).
steps.observed: Leads: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open Leads & pip") [no tile — address typed]; Opportunities: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open Leads & pip") [no tile — address typed]; Inquiries: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open CRM — Inqui") [no tile — address typed]; Quotes: refused ("Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission to open CRM — Quota") [no tile — address typed]; Quote templates: refused ("You cannot manage report templates.") [no tile — address typed]; Pre-order checklist: refuse

steps.do: Try what the permission matrix says they may do: Customer and work-order side.
steps.observed: Client register opens (TB Valves listed); dashboard "contract opened — raise the inspection call" opens the new-call form with TB Valves and AHM/C/2026-27/00001 filled in.

steps.do: Try what the matrix says they may NOT do: Leads, Opportunities, Quotes.
steps.expect: Each is refused (button absent, or a refusal sentence when the address is typed).
steps.observed: No Leads / Opportunities / Quotes tiles; /leads refused, /opportunities refused, /quotes refused with "Sales & CRM — restricted".

steps.do: Type the address of a refused screen directly.
steps.expect: Refused the same way — hiding the button is not enough.
steps.observed: /quote?id=1 → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"; /lead-new → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"; /opportunity-new → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"; /quote-new → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"; /sales-setup → "Sales & CRM — restricted You don’t have permission"
